author: ai
text: In the week of 9–15 November 2026, GDACS raised its alert for a drought in Aruba, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, French Guiana, Guyana, Panama, Suriname and Venezuela that it has tracked since 21 September 2022. On the US Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) sanctions list and the US Entity List for export controls, 2 entries were added in total over the week and none were removed. The UK Sanctions List gained 20 entries over the week and lost none. The EU's consolidated financial sanctions list had no changes. Added entries most often give an address or nationality in Russia, the United Arab Emirates and Guatemala. An entry is a person, company, vessel or aircraft, and the counts show how many entries changed, not what the measures do.
